nodes.label: TUI Sort Indicator, Vocabulary Sweep & Toast FIFO Queue (S-162 / 0.5.2 impl B)
nodes.rationale: Shows compact idle-state sort indicators fitting the 19-char 80-col border title budget (N skills·checked / N skills·order), eliminates legacy queue/Selected/Delete literals, adds n/N cancel on remove-confirm, and queues toasts FIFO in a single slot so notifications are never clobbered.
